id.description: Unique across all types; also the page path /integrations/<id>. Must match the directory name.

type.description: Must match the parent directory: integrations/<type>/<id>.

version.description: Semantic version of this integration. Bump it on every change; a published version is never changed.

casdoorVersion.description: Casdoor versions this integration can be installed on, as a semver range.

region.description: cn lists the integration only in the Chinese Marketplace: the Chinese pages of the store, and Casdoor admins using Casdoor in Chinese. For integrations with platforms only used in China; their texts and guide are written in Chinese, under en.

description.description: One or two sentences; used as the meta description and on catalog cards.

logo.description: Path of an SVG or PNG file next to integration.json.

screenshots.description: PNG or JPEG files next to integration.json, shown on the page; a theme needs at least one.

tags.description: Short capability labels shown on cards, e.g. OIDC, PKCE, Group sync.

variables.description: Values the installer asks the Casdoor admin for. Content files refer to them as {{name}}; the built-in variables casdoorUrl, clientId and clientSecret need no declaration.

permissions.description: Required for actions: the hosts the action may call.

example.description: Shown in place of the variable on the public page, e.g. https://grafana.example.com. A url has no trailing slash; a color is #rrggbb.
